shortDescription: Manage SRDF pair on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: job_id
options.description: Job ID of an asynchronous task. Can be used to get details of a job.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: rdf_target_sg_name
options.description: The name of the remote (R2) storage group on the target array. Used when the R2 storage group should have a different name from the R1 (source) storage group. If not specified, the R1 storage group name is used as the R2 storage group name. Applicable only when creating an SRDF link.

options.name: rdfg_no
options.description: The RDF group number. Optional parameter for each call. For a create operation, if specified, the array will reuse the RDF group, otherwise an error is returned. For modify and delete operations, if the RFD group number is not specified, and the storage group is protected by multiple RDF groups, then an error is raised.

options.name: remote_serial_no
options.description: Integer 12-digit serial number of remote PowerMax or VMAX array. Required while creating an SRDF link.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number will refer to the source PowerMax/VMAX array when protecting a storage group. However srdf_state operations may be issued from primary or remote array.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: Name of storage group. SRDF pairings are managed at a storage group level. Required to identify the SRDF link.

options.name: srdf_mode
options.description: The replication mode of the SRDF pair. Required when creating an SRDF pair. Can be modified by providing a required value.

options.name: srdf_state
options.description: Desired state of the SRDF pairing. While creating a new SRDF pair, allowed values are 'Establish' and 'Suspend'. If the state is not specified, the pair will be created in a 'Suspended' state. When modifying the state, only certain changes are allowed.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the SRDF pairing should exist or not. present indicates that the SRDF pairing should exist in system. absent indicates that the SRDF pairing should not exist in system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Flag to indicate if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. True signifies synchronous execution. By default, all create and update operations will be run asynchronously.

options.name: witness
options.description: Flag to specify use of Witness for a Metro configuration. Setting to True signifies to use Witness, setting it to False signifies to use Bias. It is recommended to configure a witness for SRDF Metro in a production environment, this is configured via Unisphere for PowerMax UI or REST. The flag can be set only for modifying srdf_state to either Establish, Suspend, or Restore. While creating a Metro configuration, the witness flag must be set to True.
